final_message:
All functions implemented. 11/12 tests pass (the last test needs a real `vaultctl` binary on the system).

**`src/vault.ts`:**
- `parseVaultOutput` — parses JSON, validates `path` (string), `version` (integer ≥ 1), `data` (plain object with string values), throws `VaultError` on any mismatch
- `VaultClient` — validates path with regex `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*(?:\/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)*$`; runs `<binary> read --json <path>` via `execFile`; maps `ENOENT` → `VaultToolMissingError`, exit 2 → `SecretNotFoundError`, exit 3 → `PermissionDeniedError`, other non-zero → `VaultError` with stderr

**`src/envfile.ts`:**
- `envName` — extracts last path segment, joins with field, uppercases, collapses non-alphanum runs to `_`, trims leading/trailing `_`, prefixes `_` if starts with digit; empty field → `RangeError`
- `renderEnvFile` — validates names as `[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*`, sorts by key, writes `NAME=value` lines with smart quoting (safe chars unquoted, empty = blank value, otherwise double-quoted with `\\`, `\"`, `\$`, `\n`, `\r` escaping); empty input → `""`
- `loadEnv` — reads secrets sequentially via `client.read`, maps fields with `envName`, throws `VaultError` on duplicate names
